description: Verify a valid dpt_rb_* or dpt_disp_* run bundle has been instantiated with all canonical control files, scaffold directories, and correct status values.

rules.failure_message: Bundle directory does not exist. Run instantiate-run-bundle.mjs to create it.
Missing START_FROM_HERE.md. Create it from the template.
Missing control file: rb_plan.md. Create it from the template.
Missing control file: rb_profile.yaml. Create it from the template.
Missing control file: rb_status.json. Create it from the template.
Missing control file: rb_queue.json. Create it from the template.
Missing control file: rb_trace.jsonl. Create an empty file.
Missing scaffold directory: seed_topics/. Create it.
Missing scaffold directory: reference/. Create it.
Missing scaffold directory: artifacts/. Create it.
Missing scaffold directory: final/. Create it.
Bundle directory name does not match accepted naming pattern. Production: dpt_rb_<kebab-name>. Disposable: dpt_disp_<name>_<hex>. Re-instantiate with a legal name.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'setup_ready' after instantiation.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'wave0_complete' after instantiation.
